purpose: Permanent, explicitly reviewed code-owned CI governance inputs that extend the legacy monolithic configuration fingerprint baseline without suppressing drift.

entries.reason: Required status-check context is an exact, read-only server-policy readiness input; it does not grant merge, runtime, provider, database, or Production mutation authority.
Target branch is a read-only identity binding used to reject cross-branch auto-merge registration and is constrained by the verifier to the governed main target.
Expected head SHA is a read-only exact-head freshness binding; mismatches fail closed before auto-merge registration.
PR number is a read-only identity selector used to bind readiness to one open pull request and inspect blocking labels before registration.
Repository identity is a read-only GitHub API scope binding that prevents readiness evidence from being evaluated against an unintended repository.
GH_TOKEN is a credential reference consumed only for GitHub server-side readback; no credential value is tracked or emitted and the verifier itself performs no merge or protected-ref mutation.

The default baseline-extension path is the code-owned locator for the permanent configuration governance extension authority. It selects a tracked report-only contract, contains no credential, and grants no runtime, database, protected-ref, or Production mutation authority.

Source conclusion is an exact read-only workflow-run fact used to select success-marker or bounded failure-diagnostic publication; it grants no Apply, runtime, provider, database, protected-ref, or Production mutation authority.
Readiness failure path points only to the downloaded exact-run artifact in the ephemeral Actions workspace and is used for bounded read-only diagnostic publication.
Readiness state path points only to the downloaded exact-run artifact in the ephemeral Actions workspace and is read for bounded stage metadata without runtime mutation.

RUNTIME_BASE_URL is consumed only by the bounded Migration 1051 VERIFY metadata diagnostic to address the existing admin control read surface; the diagnostic remains read-only and grants no runtime, database, provider, protected-ref, or Production mutation authority.

EVIDENCE_DIR selects only the ephemeral no-secret verification artifact directory for the bounded Migration 1051 metadata diagnostic and does not grant runtime, database, provider, protected-ref, or Production mutation authority.

BACKEND_API_KEY is a credential reference consumed only to authenticate the bounded read-only admin control metadata probe. No credential value is tracked or emitted, and the diagnostic cannot grant Apply, runtime, provider, database, protected-ref, or Production mutation authority.

RUNTIME_BASE_URL is consumed by the bounded Migration 1051 metadata-state module only to address the existing admin control read surface; this binding grants no Apply, runtime, database, provider, protected-ref, or Production mutation authority.

EVIDENCE_DIR selects only the ephemeral no-secret evidence directory written by the bounded Migration 1051 metadata-state diagnostic; it grants no runtime, database, provider, protected-ref, or Production mutation authority.

BACKEND_API_KEY is a credential reference consumed only to authenticate the bounded read-only Migration 1051 admin metadata probe. No credential value is tracked or emitted, and this binding cannot grant Apply, runtime, database, provider, protected-ref, or Production mutation authority.

METADATA_DIAGNOSTIC_MODE selects only the bounded metadata-state diagnostic behavior and remains non-authorizing; it does not grant Apply, runtime, database, provider, protected-ref, or Production mutation authority.

The authorization policy literal binds the disposable Spec 011 CI authorization row to the existing governed migration runner policy. It is code-owned, non-secret, disposable-only, and grants no Production, provider, protected-ref, or credential authority; the binder separately enforces loopback DB_HOST, the disposable database prefix, exact migration checksum, exact statement count, and production_authorized=false.

The private Recovery system-tool integration test binds a non-secret approval-challenge tool name so the server-issued authority boundary remains regression-tested; this test fixture grants no runtime, database, provider, protected-ref, credential, or Production mutation authority.
